scope: Fixed 21x51 mm board, four Pico2 bare bores and forty header contacts; source/native-footprint fit review only
recommendedDecision: Retain USB4105-GF-A at (10.5,4.975),180 degrees. Preserve all pads and contacts, fixed top bores and header anchors. Resolve the listed manufacturer-edge, cable/body and assembly tolerance conditions before fit acceptance.

ranking.contactGroupingEvidence: Manufacturer recommended pad drawing labels the four shared solder tails with both contact names. Retain all sixteen symbol terminals; both members of every shared land group have the same intended net.

ranking.reason: Full sixteen independently drilled contacts and larger nominal bore clearance at mouth flush; deeper body and through-hole assembly cost.

nativeFields.action: Relocate/hide default Value assembly field and review all fields.

ranking.stockVersusVendorLands: Native stock signal lands are diameter 0.70 mm with 0.40 mm drills; vendor drawing shows 0.65 mm lands with 0.40 mm drills. Preserve the larger stock lands; do not shrink for fit.

method.shapeDistance: Exact point-to-circle/oval/rounded-rectangle signed distance minus bore radius; 180 degree poses read back through pcbnew. Ovals use a straight center segment plus endpoint radius, not an axis-aligned box.
crossChecks: All native pads examined against all four bores.
All sixteen A/B contact names plus SH retained.
Known original conflict reproduced: -0.155582559 mm copper and +0.044417441 mm drill gap.
Independent front oval formula for first candidate: hypot(1.38,1.5)-0.5-1.05.
limits: Footprint-library primitives only; no native placed-board DRC, fabrication acceptance, force/strain proof or mating test.
Positive nominal gap is not a clearance pass; design/fabricator copper-to-hole rule and complete tolerance stack were not supplied.
Maximum diameter results include bore radius change only; no positional, drill wander, copper etch, assembly or shell tolerances.
Header fit uses fixed 1.7 mm land width envelope; fitted headers/carrier-body interference is not assessed.

separateHardwareAccess.basis: USB4105 nominal shell begins x=6.03 and top-left bore centre x=4.8. A head/washer whose XY disk overlaps the shell may interfere if their Z envelopes overlap. No head diameter, height, washer or installation direction is assumed.
separateHardwareAccess.cableAccess: Evaluate complete chosen cable overmold, Z clearance above the board, insertion/removal grip and tolerances. Vendor sectional shoulder distance supports a candidate but does not certify every cable.

rejectedDistinctStockGeometries.reason: Four wide SMT shell wings do not resolve the top bore collision at the illustrated edge pose.
Stock footprint embeds a board-edge cutout and outer front shell anchors; it is not a drop-in rectangular-outline solution. Do not silently adopt its Edge.Cuts.
Excluded: missing D+/D- terminals in the native six-pin footprints. Power-only is outside the requirement.

fallbackIfEdgeDeviationIsUnacceptable: No unconditional flush/illustrated-edge stock horizontal 16-contact solution was established in this bounded review. A reviewed vertical USB-C at an interior north-area position can preserve bores but changes cable entry; moving top bores can retain the original edge pose but changes Pico carrier fit. Neither fallback was selected or implemented.
